findings.scope: Claimed plain-comment and explicit-empty-authority XML profile
findings.reason: Current checks validate element inventories only at selected levels, values from leaf.text, and namespaces. They omit root/comment bare text and child tails, and do not restrict comment children to the authored plain text profile. The installed openpyxl deserializer ignores unknown children and container text/tails, so external readback does not close this gap.
findings.recommended_correction: Check comments root, each comment and each text container for no non-XML-whitespace bare text or child tails; require exactly one text child and no other element child in the authored plain comment profile.
